title: intent: flatten validation logic
description: Collapse the src/intent/validation directory. Move rule engine and semantic validators into a single validation.rs or a flat module structure.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a flat validation architecture.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL use the unified src/intent/validation.rs module.

unwanted.condition: IF validation rules are scattered across 5+ files
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass structural review
unwanted.because: logic fragmentation obscures the validation contract.

invariants: The set of active validation rules remains unchanged

title: intent: refactor documents module
description: Refactor src/intent/documents to use the unified domain::Spec type for markdown and vision document generation.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL generate project documentation from the unified domain model.

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a vision document is requested
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL build it from domain::Spec features.

unwanted.condition: IF document templates drift from the data model
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow document emission

preconditions: domain::Spec is the source of truth
postconditions: Documents are generated without intermediate conversions

phase_0: Replace internal doc types with domain::Spec

title: intent: cleanup util module
description: Remove redundant and over-nested utility functions from src/intent/util. Standardize on domain types where possible.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide a minimal, high-value utility set.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide it via a flat src/intent/util.rs module.

unwanted.condition: IF a utility duplicates standard library logic
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be retained

postconditions: Redundant array indexing and case-insensitive utils are removed or flattened

title: intent: remove orphaned gleam erlang refs
description: Scan and remove all remaining Gleam, Erlang, or BEAM-related configuration and build files to complete the single-binary migration.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL have zero external runtime dependencies beyond the Rust binary.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify zero .gleam or .erl files.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT be considered a single-binary distribution

postconditions: Zero non-Rust source files in src/
invariants: The build system (Moon) no longer references gleam

phase_1: Remove found files and update moon.yml

title: intent: implement execution plan resolver
description: Refactor the Resolver to produce a linear ExecutionPlan from the Spec DAG, ensuring work is ordered by dependencies.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL produce a valid execution order for all work items.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL return an ExecutionPlan containing ordered task IDs.

unwanted.condition: IF a task is placed before its dependency
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the plan to be saved

invariants: Every task in the plan is reachable from the root
